name: Industrials Momentum Breakout
description: Cross-sectional momentum breakout strategy on 11 US Industrials stocks. Entry when close breaks above the 60-day Donchian upper band, selects top 5 breakout candidates by 60-day momentum. Equal-weight allocation (20% each), weekly rebalance. Exits when a stock is no longer in the top 5 breakout candidates.
source:
# Industrials Momentum Breakout — Cross-Sectional Rotational Strategy
# =============================================================================
# Momentum breakout strategy on US Industrials stocks using 60-day Donchian
# Channels for breakout detection and cross-sectional ranking for selection.
#
# Universe: XLI, CAT, DE, GE, HON, MMM, UNP, RTX
#
# RULES:
# - Breakout: Close > Prior bar's 60-day Donchian Upper Band
# - Ranking: 60-day Rate of Change (momentum) across all assets
# - Selection: Top 5 breakout candidates by momentum each week
# - Weighting: Equal weight (1/5 = 20% each)
# - Rebalance: Weekly (first trading day of each week)
# - Exit: When a stock is no longer in the top 5 at weekly rebalance
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# 60-Day Donchian Channel (highest high / lowest low over 60 days)
donchian = donchian_channel(window=60)(src.h, src.l)
upper_band = donchian.bbands_upper

# Lag band by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias
# Today's high contributes to today's channel — compare against PRIOR bar
upper_band_prior = upper_band >> 1

# 60-Day Rate of Change for momentum ranking
momentum_60d = roc(period=60)(close)

# =============================================================================
# BREAKOUT DETECTION & CROSS-SECTIONAL SELECTION
# =============================================================================

# Breakout: Close above prior bar's 60-day Donchian upper band
breakout = close > upper_band_prior

# Mask momentum to only breakout stocks (non-breakout → null, excluded from ranking)
# This ensures cs_select only considers stocks with active breakouts
rank_signal = where(breakout, momentum_60d)

# Cross-sectional selection: top 5 breakout candidates by momentum
# Null values (non-breakout stocks) are excluded from the ranking automatically
is_top_5 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=5)(rank_signal)

# =============================================================================
# WEEKLY REBALANCE SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# Detect first trading day of each week
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week)(index())

# Enter when stock is in top 5 at week start, exit when it leaves
enter_long = is_new_week and is_top_5
exit_long = is_new_week and not is_top_5

# Hold position from weekly entry until next weekly exit
held_signal = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long-only zone
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_signal)

# Equal weight across selected stocks (1/N of active positions)
weights = equal_weight()(held_signal)

# Position sizing — equal weight, rebalance only on weekly boundary
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_week)
